basis: fixture-based: synthetic tickets, mock backends and a seeded synthetic load harness. A gate is a regression alarm for these fixtures, not a quality target for real data or real models. Timings are never gated.

gates.why: B-78 derives thresholds for a 95% target; measured 0.9833 on 2026-10-27, so 3 points of room.
Holdout half of the gold tickets; measured 1.0. Falling here means the thresholds no longer generalise even on fixtures.
The cascade must stay clearly cheaper than strong-on-everything; measured 0.2075 (relative cost units, assumed).
The rules-first tier does most of the work; measured 0.7833.
Small tier on the gold tickets; measured 0.95.
Strong tier on the gold tickets; measured 0.95.
Injection detector on the synthetic corpus; measured 1.0.
Injection detector on the synthetic corpus; measured 1.0.
A missed injection in the corpus is a regression to look at, not noise; measured 0.
No labelled PHI/NPI span may reach the prompt text; measured 0 of 34.
No labelled PII span may reach the prompt text; measured 0 of 15.
Every ticket must be refused on the hosted route when its class forbids it; measured 1.0.
The local route must still answer every ticket; measured 1.0.
Phishing verdicts against gold; measured 1.0 on 14 reports.
Injected email bodies must still be flagged; measured 1.0.
Benign corpus emails must not be flagged; measured 0.
The seeded load run must drain every job inside its sweep budget. Gate size: 120 calls, 20 clients, seed 84; the 10,000-call run is tests/py/load (B84_FULL_SCALE=1).
Every audit chain must verify after the run.
No result, record or effect may carry another client's marker.
A retry or replay must never apply an effect twice.
Every job must end done or dead-lettered, none left queued or leased.
Records written must equal records in each chain (nothing lost, nothing extra).
Every job must end as the seeded fault oracle says (status, attempts, effect, audit records).
A repeated key must collapse to one job and a changed request under a used key must be refused.

note: Edit a threshold only with a DECISIONS entry that says why; lowering one needs the owner's review. Add to CI with the file docs/changes/B-84.ci-eval-gate.yml.
